question: Does the fixed parsed standard-library inventory contain an as-yet-unassessed ownership/failure responsibility family with existing source or test evidence for a document experiment?
candidate_rule: Direct literal doc text contains ownership and at least one of error, fail, failure, using case-insensitive word/stem match; retain full inventory denominator and parser exclusions. Sort by unit ID, inspect first at most 12 matching units without ranking scores.
selection: First source-reviewed admissible family from ordered matches; do not label shared/independent by names or matching documents. If no supported family, stop as admission-incomplete.
admission: precise ownership or failure responsibility claim
source location and existing documentation/example/test evidence
possible effect on a proposed shared boundary, not just a safety fact
scope: Inventory and source-evidence admission only. No new model calls, effectiveness scores, invented labels or verifier implementation.
next_if_admitted: Separately freeze code-only/native-doc/completed-doc facts and executable obligations before any outputs; completion is factual augmentation, not formatting-only ablation
